Method of Attack: Exploits CVE-2022-0543 vulnerability in Redis servers to plant a stealthy backdoor and allow command execution
Scans port 6379 to locate exposed Redis servers
Uses Redis commands (INFO, SLAVEOF, REPLCONF, PSYNC, MODULE LOAD, SLAVEOF NO ONE) to create a replica, load malicious module 'exp_lin.so', and covert server into master
Executes arbitrary commands via loaded module
Downloads and executes Redigo malware after privilege escalation
Simulates normal Redis communication over port 6379 to evade detection
Likely uses compromised servers as bots for DDoS attacks or cryptocurrency mining, and possibly data theft
Attack Vector: Exploitation of unpatched Redis servers exposed on port 6379 via CVE-2022-0543 vulnerability
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of 'exp_lin.so' shared library on server disk
Unusual Redis commands sequence (INFO, SLAVEOF, REPLCONF, PSYNC, MODULE LOAD, SLAVEOF NO ONE)
Network traffic simulating Redis communication on port 6379
